item.title: Detroit Tigers Sign OF Austin Slater
item.description: The Detroit Tigers added veteran outfielder Austin Slater on a minor-league deal. Here’s a breakdown of his 2025 stats and what he brings to Detroit.

item.title: Radio Host Calls Out “Over-Caffeinated” Coaches Like Dan Campbell
item.description: A SiriusXM radio host took a shot at aggressive NFL coaches like Lions head coach Dan Campbell after the Seahawks’ Super Bowl victory.

item.title: Detroit Lions Bring Back Fan-Favorite Dan Skipper
item.description: The Detroit Lions are bringing back fan-favorite Dan Skipper, this time as a coach. Skipper recently worked with offensive linemen at the Senior Bowl and now joins Detroit’s staff.

item.title: Detroit Lions Could Hit Draft JACKPOT if Trend Continues
item.description: The Detroit Lions could land Top 5 draft talent at No. 17 if Ohio State safety Caleb Downs slides due to league-wide positional bias.

item.title: Field Yates Projects Massive Value Pick for Lions in 2026 NFL Draft
item.description: The Detroit Lions land Georgia OT Monroe Freeling at No. 17 in Field Yates’ latest 2026 NFL mock draft, addressing long-term needs on the offensive line.

item.title: A.J. Hinch Makes Most Predictable Announcement of All-Time
item.description: Detroit Tigers manager A.J. Hinch officially names Tarik Skubal as the 2026 Opening Day starter — a move that felt inevitable given Skubal’s rise as the team’s clear ace.

item.title: Detroit Tigers Spring Training: Dillon Dingler to be Eased into Camp
item.description: Dillon Dingler eases into spring training as the Detroit Tigers open camp in Lakeland. The young catcher is coming off a strong 2025 season and remains a key piece of the Tigers’ 2026 plans.

item.title: Scott Harris Details the Pitch That Reunited Justin Verlander With Detroit Tigers
item.description: Tigers President Scott Harris explains how Detroit’s reunion with Justin Verlander came together, including FaceTime conversations, shared goals, and unfinished business.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart, Jalen Duren Hit With Suspensions After Pistons-Hornets Fight
item.description: The NBA has suspended Detroit Pistons big man Isaiah Stewart and center Jalen Duren following an on-court altercation against the Hornets. Full details and impact.

item.title: When Will Justin Verlander Make His First Start For The Tigers In 2026? Here’s the Best Bet
item.description: When will Justin Verlander make his first start for the Detroit Tigers in 2026? A look at the schedule, rotation depth, and why the home opener makes the most sense.
